scope.intervals: Phase assigned by endpoint; all crossing intervals retained.100ms global offsets integrate both native50ms subintervals.
scope.speed_bins: Coast-endpoint intervals classified by maximum observed actor speed among all native points in the interval; fixed descriptive bins only.
scope.native_sample_speed: Phase speed statistics use all native20Hz samples, not decimated100ms endpoints.
scope.route_cte: Worker-recorded route projection checked against fixed operational bound; not independently reprojected by this offline summary.
scope.camera_anchors: First even native tick at/after first coast observation; final even tick at/before expected final native tick. Never substitute an earlier available bundle. Trace ends at the same camera tick.
scope.interpretation: Observed low-speed dwell is not exact standstill, physical actuator timing, a learned result, or permission to change labels/gates/noise tolerances.
